newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Analysts' comments on KLM Q3 results.
newsitem.headline: Analysts' comments on KLM Q3 results.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines said on Tuesday it made a net loss of 7.0 million guilders in the third quarter, compared to a 102 million guilder profit a year earlier. It made an operating loss of 19.0 million against a 56.0 million profit in the year earlier period.

Analysts' forecasts for third quarter net results ranged from a loss of 54 million guilders to a profit of 12 million guilders. Operating results were seen ranging from a 25 million guilder loss to a profit of 35 million.
Below is a collection of analysts' comments on the results.

Gert Jochems, NIB Strating - "I downgraded the company earlier this week from a hold to a sell and from market performer to underperformer. It confirms (my decision). When you look at the employee costs you see that cost control is really necessary. All in all it was in line (with my forecasts). On the operating side, it's worst than I thought."

Thibaud de Guerre, ING Barings - "At first glance the results are more or less in line with estimates. Operating figures are slightly less than what we expected, with the difference due to rising fuel costs which were not compensated by rising yield. I maintain the stock on a sell recommendation."

Bert van Hoogenhuyze, Amstgeld - "The operating result is not far from what I was expecting. The forecast is also the same as three months ago which will put them at (a net profit of) about 390 million (guilders for the year).... but we can see that the operating profit of KLM is going down pretty sharply....(KLM) also said it will not include the Northwest equity in the fourth quarter which seems a little strange. It's not yet clear why."

Ab Barneveld, Generale Bank - "We stick to a sell recommendation for KLM since the (size of) the third quarter operating loss is disappointing and KLM's expectations for the fourth quarter are lower than we had estimated. Making a quick calculation the loss in the fourth quarter could mount to 120 million guilders while we had expected a 110 million loss. The share price could drop well below 50 guilders per share."

By 1153 GMT KLM's shares were trading down 50 cents on the day at 54.00 guilders. Shortly before the figures they stood at 54.10 guilders although they spiked up to the day's high of 55.50 guilders just after the results announcement.
